newsitem.title: USA: Ice Ban president to retire, CEO succeeds.
newsitem.headline: Ice Ban president to retire, CEO succeeds.

text.p: Ice Ban America Inc said Friday that Warren Johnson, one of its founders and president, will retire in order to continue pursuing real estate developments, his primary profession.
The company said George Janke, has been named president and will continue as board chairman and chief executive officer.
Ice Ban is a development stage company that has acquired patents rights to a biodegradable, non-corrosive roadway de-icing agent.
